claims: Andrej Stojaković was born on August 17, 2004.
Andrej Stojaković is the son of Peja Stojaković.
Peja Stojaković is a former NBA All-Star.
Andrej Stojaković is a 6'7" guard/forward.
Andrej Stojaković played for Stanford.
Andrej Stojaković played for California.
Andrej Stojaković transferred to the University of Illinois for the 2025-26 season.
Andrej Stojaković was a 2023 McDonald's All-American.
Andrej Stojaković was born in Greece to Peja Stojaković and Aleka Kamila.
Andrej Stojaković grew up in Carmichael, California.
Andrej Stojaković attended Jesuit High School.
Andrej Stojaković played his freshman year for the Cardinal at Stanford in 2023–2024.
Andrej Stojaković transferred to the California Golden Bears for 2024–2025.
Andrej Stojaković committed to the Fighting Illini in April 2025.
Andrej Stojaković is at Illinois from 2025–present.
The University of Illinois Athletics bio describes Andrej Stojaković as a 5-star recruit.
Andrej Stojaković was a Jersey Mike's Naismith All-American.
Andrej Stojaković participated in the Nike Hoop Summit.
As of late 2025, Andrej Stojaković has been navigating a knee injury while joining the Illinois program.
Andrej Stojaković is the eldest child of Peja Stojaković.
Peja Stojaković had a 13-year NBA career.
Peja Stojaković won a championship with the Dallas Mavericks in 2011.
